name: Original page images / user PDFs
role: Ground truth for what is visibly printed; page crops, layout and exact edition
limitations: Must be retained and inspected; no automatic transcription is ground truth.

name: Visually adjudicated bilingual dictionary gold set
role: Measure headword accuracy, IPA fidelity, Persian CER, entry assignment and reading order
limitations: Start with pages 57–59 as pilot; reserve held-out pages; never train on evaluation labels.

name: PyMuPDF
role: Inspect PDF text layer, image regions and block/word coordinates
limitations: Sort or text-layer sequence is not guaranteed to match human reading order.

name: Surya 0.22.1
role: Page layout, lines, reading order, tables and an alternative OCR reading
limitations: Runtime/models not validated from this ZIP; version and model weights licensing require separate verification; avoid claiming latest README applies to 0.22.1.

name: Tesseract and tessdata_best (fas, eng)
role: Independent OCR baseline and word geometry/confidence
limitations: Confidence does not establish correctness; dictionary IPA requires independent inspection.

name: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 Arabic-script recognition
role: Second independent candidate reading for Persian/English text
location: existing optional adapter; models not validated
limitations: Model language support does not establish accuracy on bilingual dictionary pages.

name: Hazm 0.12.1
role: Diagnostic Unicode, spacing, tokenization and morphology checks on Persian-only spans
limitations: Never normalize whole mixed English/IPA/Persian entries; default settings can delete marks and alter source text.

name: Aryanpour index and JSONL
role: Candidate English headwords, spelling forms and potentially edition-matched Persian definitions
limitations: Edition/source correspondence to scanned pages must be established before source matching.

name: Hezareh lexical index
role: Corroborate lexical candidates; use verification metadata
limitations: Most records are raw OCR and cannot serve as exact-image ground truth.

name: فرهنگستان زبان و ادب فارسی — دستور خط فارسی
role: Evaluate spelling, prefix/suffix writing and ZWNJ conventions in a separate reviewed layer
limitations: Normative rules do not authorize modernization of original historical print.

name: نجفی — غلط ننویسیم
role: Investigate unusual Persian usage only after verifying the scanned entry
limitations: OCR navigation is not evidence of Najafi's wording.

name: Saeed Yousef — Persian: A Comprehensive Grammar
role: Check plausible Persian grammar and word structure after segmentation
limitations: Grammar plausibility does not prove the OCR matches the printed page.

name: English_Farsi_Advanced.BGL
role: Potential existing electronic spelling/definition lookup if provenance and edition match
location: previously uploaded in conversation (not confirmed in repository)
limitations: Do not claim same printed edition or reproduce proprietary dictionary data without checking rights.

name: English Speller Database (ESDB)
role: English headword spellings, variants, inflections and candidates for OCR errors
limitations: Dictionary headwords include names, variants and domain terms absent from spellcheck lists; candidates not authoritative.

name: ipa-dict
role: UK/US pronunciation candidate comparison
limitations: Printed phonetic notation is edition-specific; check underlying third-party dataset licenses.

name: Wiktextract / extracted Wiktionary
role: Independent headword and POS/pronunciation candidate enrichment
limitations: Edition and licenses of extracted Wiktionary data must be respected; never treat as scanned-page source.

name: Arshasb Persian OCR dataset
role: Test Persian word/line localization and general Persian page segmentation
limitations: Public 7k page subset uses limited font/content; verify dataset license and applicability before training.

name: Garshasp-70C synthetic Persian OCR
role: Line recognition robustness and possible training/fine-tuning after baseline
location: Hugging Face; do not download full corpus by default
limitations: Synthetic 48x640 lines; not an unbiased book layout or dictionary accuracy benchmark; card lists CC BY 4.0.

name: Kraken OCR
role: Train font/edition-specific OCR if a measured bottleneck remains
limitations: Requires appropriately licensed labeled line images and held-out evaluation.

name: Unicode UAX #9 — Bidirectional Algorithm
role: Separate logical Unicode text order from its rendered visual order
limitations: Correct screen rendering does not repair OCR reading-order extraction.

name: Unicode UAX #29 — Text Segmentation
role: Distinguish codepoints, grapheme clusters and boundary scoring
limitations: Default segmentation needs Persian and dictionary-specific tailoring.

name: Universal OCR Toolkit (prior conversation artifact)
role: Generic pipeline prototype to evaluate for integration
location: previous chat downloadable ZIP; not tools/universal-ocr/ in master
limitations: Documentation in this folder does not mean this generic toolkit has been merged or installed.
